summary.result: The analysis results showed that maximum temperature and maximum new snow depth had nonlinear effects on ski expenditures, while precipitation had linear effects.
summary.background: The ski tourism industry, reliant on winter temperatures and snow, is highly vulnerable to climate change.
summary.method: To address this, we analyzed the nonlinear effects of daily weather elements on ski tourism demand in South Korea from 2018 to 2019 using a generalized additive model and big data on ski resort credit card expenditures.
